column5: Confirm, change or complement answer/explanation from 2023

column2: 2.1 Portal features

Is there a national portal in your country for that enables users to search for open datasets and find where to download open data? 

For Explanation:
* If yes, please provide the URL of the national portal.

For Explanation:
* What is the technology stack of your portal (e.g. based on uData, CKAN, etc.)
column7: Own back-end based on collecting data in DCAT-AP + enhancing via SPARQL queries, SKOS-mappings and SHACL validation, front-end is a Drupal website that's unaware of DCAT (or any other metadata spec) . See also https://github.com/fedict/dcattools)

2.4 Portal sustainability

Does the national portal have a strategy to ensure its sustainability?

For Explanation:
* If yes, please (1) provide the URL to this document and (2) describe the main measures to keep the portal running in the long-term and continue to serve its audience
column7:
See page https://data.gov.be/fr/gestion-et-continuite
A) hosting / update is done by the FPS BOSA
B) at least 3 times a year a meeting with other portal owners/metadata providers to make sure this community remains active and metadata can be harvested from other portals
C) participation in the Belgium Open Data community (e.g. OpenKnowledge Belgium)
D) citizens and companies can ask for a one-to-one virtual meeting to discuss their open data needs and projects
